description:
Intetics Inc., a leading American technology company specializing in custom software application development, distributed professional teams creation, software product quality assessment, and “all-things-digital” solutions, is looking for a  IT Service Manager / Senior IT Service Manager to join our team.

Long-term cooperation on an as-needed basis, with potential part-time assignments and travel to the client’s office if required

Our client is an international organization supporting global environmental and sustainability initiatives. The engagement focuses on developing and supporting enterprise applications, digital services, and technology solutions used across the organization. Specialists will collaborate with internal teams and external partners in an international environment, following established architecture, security, and delivery standards.

We are looking for an IT Service Manager to coordinate the delivery, support, and ongoing operation of enterprise applications and digital services. You will connect business owners, technical teams, and vendors to ensure service quality, transparent communication, and continuous improvement. The Senior IT Service Manager will additionally oversee multiple concurrent services and their performance.

Responsibilities

  • Prioritize and track service requests, incidents, issues, enhancements, and service backlogs.
  • Coordinate operational support and ensure timely resolution of service issues.
  • Translate business needs into service priorities and manage stakeholder expectations.
  • Monitor service performance, user feedback, vendor delivery, and corrective actions.
  • Coordinate incident, problem, and change management activities.
  • Prepare changes for governance reviews, including Change Advisory Board processes.
  • Maintain service documentation and provide clear status and performance reporting.
  • For the senior role: oversee multiple services, coordinate dependencies, and define and improve SLAs and KPIs.
  • At least 5 years of experience in IT service management, digital service delivery, application support, IT operations, or a related function; at least 7 years for the senior role.
  • At least 3 years of experience in each of the following:
    • Coordinating operational delivery and support of digital services or enterprise applications.
    • Using Jira for service backlogs, issue tracking, prioritization, and reporting.
    • Applying incident, problem, and change management practices.
    • Coordinating business owners, technical teams, and external vendors.
  • Previous experience working with the United Nations or a comparable multilateral organization is required.
  • Bachelor’s degree or highest-level professional education in a relevant discipline; a bachelor’s degree or higher is required for the senior role.
  • At least one relevant certification, such as ITIL 4 Foundation, ISO/IEC 20000, COBIT Foundation, or a relevant ServiceNow certification.

Additional requirements for the senior role

  • At least 5 years of experience managing multiple concurrent digital or IT services.
  • At least 3 years of experience defining, monitoring, reporting on, and improving SLAs, KPIs, or comparable service commitments.
  • An advanced relevant certification, such as ITIL 4 Managing Professional, Practice Manager, Strategic Leader, ISO/IEC 20000 Practitioner/Lead Implementer, or equivalent.

Would be a plus:

  • For university degrees, the awarding institution must rank among the top 500 in an overall or subject-specific university ranking
  • Experience working with or for large organizations with complex structures and multiple business units
